jobs.occupation: W2 Professorship “Sustainable Freight Transport Systems and Transport Logistics" (Ingenieur/in - Verkehrswesen)
jobs.description: W2 Professorship “Sustainable Freight Transport Systems and Transport Logistics"Application deadline:30.12.2026Date of hire:as soon as possibleVacancy number:39565We are seeking an academically outstanding individual (m/f/d) who will make an independent inter- and transdisciplinary contribution to research in the field of sustainable freight transport systems and logistics. The content focus is at the intersection of value chains, freight transport, and sustainable production systems. The professorship shall connect and strengthen the sustainability-related systems analytical topics at the Kassel Institute for Sustainability and the transportation science topics in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. Moreover, there is an aim to foster networking in the fields of supply chains and intralogistics with the relevant departments of Economics and Mechanical Engineering. This is intended to further the interdisciplinary interaction between technical and societal research approaches and to advance the research focus on sustainable transformation at the University of Kassel.The professorship should focus on at least one of the following topics:1. Systemic analysis of the interdependencies between freight transport systems, trade, and economic development: Origin of freight transport, economic and ecological evaluation of interregional division of labor, interactions between infrastructure (e.g., rail), regional production clusters and division of labor, as well as sustainable design of these relationships.2. Modeling of the freight transport system: Development and application of scenarios and models for the origin, development, and management of freight transport, infrastructure development and the associated policy instruments, as well as the advancement of corresponding methods.3. Development and application of comprehensive approaches for sustainability evaluation of the ecological, social, and economic effects of strategies and interventions in freight transport, as well as, based on these, the design of a sustainable freight transport system.Experience in the collection, analysis, and management of data in the context of the transformation towards a sustainable freight transport system is also desirable, including the consideration of AI methods: development of data collection procedures and methods of data analysis and data-driven forecasts based on statistical and AI methods, issues regarding the (public) availability and use of data.In teaching, the professorship should supplement and enhance existing degree programs in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, and to develop new or emerging study programs with a focus on sustainability. Teaching responsibilities are to be divided, with 50% in sustainability-related degree programs and 50% in offerings within the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering. Some courses must be taught in English. It is expected that the appointee, especially regarding official duties in teaching and academic self-administration, will acquire sufficient proficiency in the German language in due course, if not already possessed.The main location for the professorship will be at the Kassel Institute for Sustainability.Special notes: The department aims to increase the proportion of female professors and expressly encourages female scientists to apply.The requirements for appointment and performance are in accordance with §§ 67, 68 HessHG. Specifically, a completed, qualified doctorate as well as a habilitation or equivalent additional academic achievements, as evidenced by scientific publications, are required. You should also possess pedagogical aptitude and commitment to academic teaching, as well as a pronounced willingness for interdisciplinary collaboration.Please submit a curriculum vitae, certificates, diplomas, a list of scientific works, three selected publications, a research and teaching concept (maximum three pages each), as well as a list of previous courses taught, existing teaching evaluations, and any higher education didactic trainings with your application. Additionally, please submit a brief concept (maximum three pages) outlining your ideas for a professional and institutional connection to the Kassel Institute for Sustainability.For questions, please contact Prof. Dr. Angela Francke, Tel.: +49 561 804-7703, Email: angela.francke(at)uni-kassel.de. We kindly ask you to submit the complete application documents as a single PDF document via the University of Kassel's application portal.

This role is particularly well suited to early-career professionals with a strong technical background who are keen to build hands-on experience in technical sales, customer management and business development within specialty chemicals.Key Responsibilities:- Support the identification and development of business opportunities in markets such as Home Care, Industrial & Institutional Cleaning, Textiles, Starch, Water Treatment, Pulp & Paper and other selected process industries.- Contribute to the preparation and implementation of sales and marketing plans for selected customers, applications and target markets.- Work with existing and prospective customers to understand their needs and translate them into potential commercial opportunities, with support from experienced colleagues.- Support the positioning and promotion of our product range in Home Care and selected industrial applications.- Coordinate customer-related activities and technical sales projects together with sales, business development, application technology and customer service teams.Your Profile:- Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Business Chemistry or a related technical discipline; jobs.description: Sie sind ein wichtiger Teil unserer Zukunft. Hoffentlich sind wir auch ein Teil Ihrer Zukunft! Bei B. Braun schützen und verbessern wir die Gesundheit der Menschen weltweit. Sie unterstützen diese Vision, indem Sie Ihr Know-how einbringen und Innovation, Effizienz und Nachhaltigkeit als Werte teilen. Braun SEStellenstandort:  Melsungen, Hessen, DeutschlandFunktionsbereich:  InformationstechnologieArbeitsmodell:  HybridAnforderungsnummer:  7530Head of Platform & Solutions Operations (f/m/d)  The Group Digital Department, is looking for a Head of Platform & Solutions Operations. The Head of Platform & Solutions Operations is responsible for running B. Braun's Customer facing Integrated Solutions Portfolio and Digital Foundation platform in production, end to end. Service Integration, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), incident/problem/change management, observability, and service-level management all sit within this role's operating model. You act as the primary interface between the Digital Foundation's platform teams and the internal service organizations. You own the operating model end-to-end: starting with a pilot on one integrated solution in your first months, and scaling from there into a sustainable, audit-proof operating capability.  Tasks and responsibilities: - You build a pilot for one integrated solution within your first months, delivering it end-to-end with agreed interfaces, real SLOs in use, and a functioning stakeholder feedback loop- You design and implement a Service Integration (SIAM) operating model across multiple internal providers, including IT Service Desk, Global Business Service, and Global Technical Service- You introduce SLOs and error budgets on top of the observability stack and use them to drive prioritization and operational decisions- You establish modern, risk-tiered change management practices based on GitOps and policy-as-code principles- You build, lead, and grow an operational team or competence center that ensures reliable platform operations in production- You collaborate with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to define and fulfill supplier obligations under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485- You represent platform operations to internal and external stakeholders, communicating risks, incidents, and the roadmap in a transparent manner. Professional Qualifications:- You hold a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a comparable field- You bring more than 8 years of experience in platform or production operations, including several years in a leadership position- You have hands-on experience implementing SLOs, observability practices, and incident response processes in live production environments- You have successfully designed and operated a Service Integration (SIAM) or comparable multi-provider operating model- You possess practical experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud-native platforms, Kubernetes, and GitOps-based change enablement- You have worked in regulated or compliance-sensitive production environments, ideally with ISO 27001 / SOC 2, while experience with IEC 62304 and ISO 13485 is a strong advantage- You communicate fluently in English and work confidently in German with enterprise stakeholders. Personal Competencies: - You build trust and collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries, including with stakeholders who do not report directly to you and in virtual, cross-site environments- You are self-motivated and hands-on while remaining calm and decisive during major incidents- You combine a structured and analytical mindset with the ability to act quickly under pressure- You are genuinely curious about modern operations and continuously expand your knowledge as technology platforms and regulatory requirements evolve. Benefits: - Company pension scheme- Mobility benefits, e.g., the B. Braun Job Ticket or Job Bike- Family-support services, e.g., vacation childcare- Flexible working hours such as flextime and mobile work- Employee discounts- Various working models, e.g., job sharing/part-time  Diversity makes us stronger! That is why we explicitly encourage people of all identities, lifestyles, and backgrounds to apply. B. Braun SE | Haakon Schröder | +49160 95704687

jobs.description: Minimum qualifications:- Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.- 9 years of experience working in mission-critical facility maintenance and operations.- Ability to communicate in English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.Preferred qualifications:- Experience working in data center environments, including building and operating infrastructure.- Experience in initiating and executing strategic initiatives in a global environment.- Ability to perform operational assessment and risk analysis of third-party sites.- Ability to forecast resource requirements in a data-driven way.- Excellent problem-solving skills.About the JobThe Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facility Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems.
